identity_evidence: MOUNT FUJI ARCHITECTS STUDIO identifies the project as Roadside Station in Mashiko, Tochigi, completed in 2016, with roadside station as its principal use.
The official project data records one storey, 1,328.84 square metres total floor area and construction from September 2015 to September 2016.

The official roadside-station operator and Kanto Michi-no-Eki listing confirm the Nagatsutsumi 2271 address, parking, restaurant and retail operation. These support transport-hub primary and retail secondary without expanding the building to community-center or public-space.
